core.title: Warwick Rough Iron Ring Pull, Acorn WPBBP

text.description_html:
Acorn WPBBP, Rough Iron Warwick Door Ring Pull

This is a great engraved pull ring that will match any home with old world decor perfectly; but it can add its rich early European feel to any place a ring pull would be good. Plus, Acorn's WPBBP Warwick Iron Ring Pull can be used both inside and outside your home. Easy two screw installation. The rough iron surface duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the natural weathering of iron; and it has a lifetime no rust warranty.

When combined with our other great Hand Forged Iron Products, Acorn can really make your home stand out.

Specifications for the Acorn Warwick Rough Iron Ring Door Pull:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Length: 6-1/4"
  • Width: 3-1/4"
  • Ring Diameter: 4"
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold individually. Package includes 1 pull and hardware for a surfaced mounting application. This door pull is handmade and all dimensions are approximate.
